knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Wiping with the grain keeps the strokes aligned with the finish, so fine scratches are not created.
The gentlest method is used first, and polish is applied only after the stronger steps are complete and the surface is dry.
A wet surface can smear or dilute the polish, so it will not buff evenly unless the metal is dry first.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the finish and the grain direction before starting.
Uses glass cleaner first and steps up only if needed, with every stroke along the grain.
Applies polish to a dry surface and buffs it off evenly with no smears.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Abrasive pad used on stainless steel without supervisor approval
Product applied to a wet surface where it smears
